other_conditions: Applicant must be a graduate or diploma holder in agriculture or allied subjects from recognized universities or agencies
Diploma holders must have at least 50% marks
Intermediate (plus two) agriculture‑related courses require at least 55% marks
Qualifications may require approval of the Department of Agriculture & Cooperation based on state government recommendation
benefits_summary: Provides full financial support, training, and credit‑linked subsidies to set up agri‑clinics and agri‑business centres offering extension services and entrepreneurship opportunities for farmers.
